items.title: OpenAI推出药物研发AI模型
items.raw_excerpt: OpenAI正推出一款旨在加速药物发现的人工智能（AI）模型早期版本。该模型名为GPT-Rosalind，面向生命科学研究，例如帮助从海量数据中提取见解，将科研转化为面向患者的医疗应用。OpenAI称，该模型将首先以研究预览形式向部分企业客户开放。首批用户包括制药商安进、疫苗制造商莫德纳以及生物科学研究非营利机构Allen Institute。OpenAI、Anthropic以及Alphabet旗下谷歌正日益聚焦AI在科学和医疗领域的应用，包括辅助新药研发、分析个人医疗数据等。（新浪财经）

title_i18n.zh: OpenAI推出药物研发AI模型
title_i18n.en: OpenAI launches an AI model for drug development.
title_i18n.es: OpenAI lanza un modelo de IA para el desarrollo de fármacos.

excerpt_i18n.zh: OpenAI正推出一款旨在加速药物发现的人工智能（AI）模型早期版本。该模型名为GPT-Rosalind，面向生命科学研究，例如帮助从海量数据中提取见解，将科研转化为面向患者的医疗应用。OpenAI称，该模型将首先以研究预览形式向部分企业客户开放。首批用户包括制药商安进、疫苗制造商莫德纳以及生物科学研究非营利机构Allen Institute。OpenAI、Anthropic以及Alphabet旗下谷歌正日益聚焦AI在科学和医疗领域的应用，包括辅助新药研发、分析个人医疗数据等。（新浪财经）
excerpt_i18n.en: OpenAI is launching an early version of an artificial intelligence (AI) model designed to accelerate drug discovery. Named GPT-Rosalind, the model targets life sciences research, such as helping extract insights from vast data and translating scientific research into patient-focused medical applications. OpenAI stated that the model will initially be available to select enterprise customers in a research preview format. The first users include pharmaceutical manufacturer Amgen, vaccine maker Moderna, and the nonprofit biomedical research institution Allen Institute. OpenAI, Anthropic, and Alphabet's Google are increasingly focusing on AI applications in science and healthcare, including assisting in new drug development and analyzing personal medical data. (Sina Finance)
excerpt_i18n.es: OpenAI está lanzando una versión preliminar de un modelo de inteligencia artificial (IA) diseñado para acelerar el descubrimiento de fármacos. Este modelo, llamado GPT-Rosalind, está orientado a la investigación en ciencias de la vida, como ayudar a extraer conocimientos de grandes volúmenes de datos y transformar la investigación científica en aplicaciones médicas dirigidas a pacientes. OpenAI afirma que el modelo se pondrá inicialmente a disposición de algunos clientes empresariales en forma de vista previa de investigación. Los primeros usuarios incluyen al fabricante farmacéutico Amgen, al productor de vacunas Moderna y al instituto sin ánimo de lucro Allen Institute para la investigación en biociencias. OpenAI, Anthropic y Google, propiedad de Alphabet, están centrándose cada vez más en la aplicación de la IA en los campos de la ciencia y la medicina.

items.title: Runtime security for AI agents(injection,tool abuse, data exfiltration)
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN I’ve been working on an open-source project to explore a problem I keep running into with LLM systems in production: We give models the ability to call tools, access data, and make decisions…
but we don’t have a real runtime security layer around them. So I built a system that acts as a control plane for AI behavior, not just infrastructure. GitHub: https://github.com/dshapi/AI-SPM What it does The system sits around an LLM pipeline and enforces decisions in real time: Detects and blocks prompt injection (including obfuscation attempts)
Forces structured tool calls (no direct execution from the model)
Validates tool usage against policies
Prevents data leakage (PII / sensitive outputs)
Streams all activity for detection + audit
Architecture (high-level)
Gateway layer for request cont

items.title: Open-source AI runtime security
items.raw_excerpt: "Runtime security" in the AI vendor pitch usually means request-time: inspect the prompt as it arrives, inspect the response as it leaves, block if either looks wrong. This is one runtime. It is where prompt injection classifiers, jailbreak detectors, toxicity filters, output moderation, and guardrails frameworks operate. Recent leaked source code from an AI application has shown that even a regex is sometimes enough to do this job.

items.title: Marky – A lightweight Markdown viewer for agentic coding
items.raw_excerpt: Hey HN, In this age of agentic coding I've found myself spending a lot of time reviewing markdown files. Whether it's plans or documentation that I've asked my agent to generate for me, it seems that I spend more time reading markdown than code. I've tried a few different solutions to make it easier to read such as Obsidian however I've found their Vault system to be quite limiting for this use case and I've found TUI solutions to not quite be as friendly to read as I've wanted so I made Marky. Marky is a lightweight desktop application that makes it incredibly easy to read and track your markdown files. It also has a helpful cli so you can just run marky FILENAME and have the app open to the md file that you pointed it at. I've been using the daily over the past week and I really enjoy it
